Terms of Use

Using the tools

PakToolkit tools are provided free of charge for personal and business use, as-is. You may use the files and results they produce for any lawful purpose.

Accuracy

Calculators use published rates and formulas that we work to keep current, but rates, slabs and rules change through official notifications. Results are estimates for guidance; official figures from the relevant authority (your electricity DISCO, FBR, an admitting university, or the notified nisab) are always final. PakToolkit is not responsible for decisions taken solely on the basis of an estimate.

Your responsibility

You are responsible for the files you process and for checking results before submitting them to any official portal. Do not use these tools for unlawful purposes.

Availability

We aim to keep PakToolkit online and fast, but uninterrupted availability is not guaranteed. Tools may be updated, improved or removed without notice.

PakToolkit — free online tools for Pakistan. Every tool runs in your browser; your files never leave your device.
